# MealCoreAI
> AI-powered personalised Indian meal planning for PCOS, Diabetes, Thyroid, Pregnancy, Kids, and Weight Loss.

## About
MealCoreAI generates daily personalised Indian meal plans adapted to the user's specific health condition, routine, and food preferences. Plans are ready in 90 seconds. Free to start.
